examples.title: Complete packet
examples.description: Every document type the policy asks for: two paystubs, two bank statement months, a 2025 W-2 and photo IDs. The review still refers, because the W-2 does not extract and the paystub YTD gross is inconsistent (see the README).
examples.tryIt: Ask about the monthly income, then run the review and read the checks it flags.

examples.title: Missing documents
examples.description: One paystub and one month of bank statements. The policy asks for two of each.
examples.tryIt: Run the review and check which documents it reports as missing.

examples.title: Identity conflict
examples.description: The paystub, bank statement, passport and driver's license each name a different person.
examples.tryIt: Run the review and read the identity findings.
